subject: Renewal + billing cadence change request — quarterly billing and capacity top-up for Nimbus
messages:
From: Emily Brown <emily.brown@nimbushealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nimbus Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>, AWS Marketplace <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion — shift to quarterly billing + capacity increase

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from Nimbus as we approach the Oct renewal for our AWS Marketplace agreement (current term ends 2028-10-15). We want to: 
- Increase our Dedicated capacity from 4 reserved GPUs to 8 reserved GPUs starting Nov 1 (to support a new model rollout)
- Move billing cadence from annual prepay to quarterly invoicing if possible

Procurement asked me to reach out to understand whether Redwood can support quarterly invoices via an AWS Marketplace path (preferably a Private Offer) and how that will affect pricing and billing/proration for the Oct->Nov cutover. We also need the revised PO so we can route to our AP team — goal is to have PO in place by Sep 15.

A couple of constraints on our side: AP requires an itemized PO (line for capacity, line for support) and they prefer Net30. We can provide the official PO once we have the private-offer/pricing fixture.

Can you confirm options and next steps? Happy to hop on a quick call this week.

Thanks,
Emily Brown
Director of Platform Engineering
Nimbus Health
[attachment: nimbus_usage_last12mos.csv (text/csv)]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Brown <emily.brown@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Sep 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — shift to quarterly billing + capacity increase

Marissa / Dev / Ben — looping you in. Emily from Nimbus wants to: bump Dedicated GPUs 4->8 on Nov 1 and move to quarterly invoicing. Procurement needs an itemized PO and Net30. They want PO by Sep 15.

Plan / asks: 
- Marissa: can you draft a variant for the AWS path (Private Offer) with two options: (A) 12-month commitment billed quarterly (tranches) and (B) 3-month pilot + 9-month remainder billed quarterly? Include itemized lines (capacity, premium support, optional burst credits). Attach the raw draft that we can attach to their PO.
- Dev: validate capacity mapping / availability Nov 1 for 8 reserved GPUs and whether we need to schedule a capacity reservation in Dedicated. Also confirm SLO impact for the larger cohort.
- Ben (Finance): confirm we can accept Net30 on the PO, and advise on proration for Oct->Nov overlap if the current annual commitment is still active. Also confirm how we should represent quarterly invoices in our accounting for an AWS Marketplace private offer (invoice vs Marketplace billing).

Emily — I’ll route a draft today and flag anything that requires legal redline. If the Private Offer path won’t support true quarter-to-quarter committment, we’ll propose a 12mo commitment split into quarterly invoices (common workaround).

Thanks all,
Kimberly Park
Head of Cloud Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Brown <emily.brown@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Sep 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — shift to quarterly billing + capacity increase

Thanks Kim — attaching a draft PO workbook and a suggested pricing sheet.

Summary of what I have so far (high level):
- Option 1 (recommended): 12-month commitment, billed quarterly (4 tranches). Effective date 2028-11-01. Pricing: tiered unit price with 8 reserved GPUs baseline plus support add-on. Quarterly invoice issued at start of each quarter tranche; Redwood invoices to Nimbus AP (Net30).
- Option 2: 3-month pilot (smaller capacity delta) followed by 9-month tranche billed quarterly — this reduces upfront $ but requires an amendment mid-term which Procurement said they dislike.

Key notes:
- AWS Marketplace/Private Offer does not natively support true month-to-month or quarter-to-quarter commitments where the customer can cancel without financial obligation; Marketplace Private Offers typically encode a minimum term. The pragmatic path is an annual commitment split for billing, which meets Nimbus' AP need for quarterly invoices while preserving Marketplace contract mechanics.
- I'll attach a workbook (Nimbus_AWS_PO_Draft_2028.xlsx) with line items suitable for a PO (capacity, support SLA, optional burst credits). Please review the itemized lines for accounting codes.

Next steps: 
1) Ben: confirm if quarterly invoices on a 12mo commitment present any internal revenue recognition issues and whether we need to issue a single invoice and then internal split — otherwise we'll proceed with quarterly invoices.
2) Dev: confirm capacity reservation and if we need to schedule dedicated infra changes (I've penciled Nov 1 but want a green light).
3) Kimberly: if the above looks good, I'll convert the workbook into an AWS Private Offer payload and start the Marketplace submission; that process may take 3-7 business days once submitted.

Attachment: Nimbus_AWS_PO_Draft_2028.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

-Marissa
Director, Marketplace Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Emily Brown <emily.brown@nimbushealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Sep 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — shift to quarterly billing + capacity increase

Kimberly / Marissa / Ben / Dev — thanks for the fast turn. Nimbus is comfortable with the proposed pragmatic path: 12-month term, billed in quarterly tranches (invoices will be issued quarterly; Net30). We will sign a PO reflecting the Nov 1 effective date and the capacity increase to 8 reserved GPUs.

Attached is our official PO and a signed SOW for the expanded capacity. Please confirm receipt and that the Private Offer submission will be kicked off this week so AWS Marketplace can process prior to Nov 1. We also attached the AP contact info — they require the invoice to reference the PO number and remit to the address on the PDF.

Attachments: PO_Nimbus_2028.pdf (application/pdf), signed_sow_nimbus.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
